question: Is there already a deposited S-KO nuclei dataset in which the oligodendrocyte-lineage composition and AMPA receptor genes in OPCs can be read before any bench work
system: public snRNA-seq of S-KO versus S-Control hippocampus (the deposit analysed in the NB-4 package; first confirm it is the dataset the Wwox paper reports as data not shown)
arms: descriptive only: share of OPC, committed, premyelinating, mature nuclei per arm; Gria2/Gria3/Gria4 in OPC nuclei; no replicate structure invented, one pool per arm
result_if_signal_or_contact: premyelinating share low with AMPAR genes unchanged: a step block not obviously linked to activity
result_if_activity_linked: AMPAR genes shifted as in the activity-reduced pattern of the neonatal study: activity-linked reading gains weight (inference, pooled data)
needs: none; NB-4 notes on glial contamination of that deposit must be read first
order_and_limits: first; cheap; cannot settle cause, can retire or raise H2

question: Is the null-neuron deficit carried by contact or by a soluble product, and does it need neuronal state
system: same co-culture format as the Wwox paper: wild-type OPCs on wild-type or Wwox-null DRG neurons
arms: (a) direct contact; (b) wild-type OPCs on wild-type DRG with medium from null DRG; (c) null-DRG medium on OPCs alone; (d) wild-type OPCs on fixed null DRG (substrate only)
read_by_level: level 1 (BCAS1/CC1/MBP shares), level 2 (MBP wrapping, paranodal marker, EM g-ratio); level 3 and 4 not available in the dish
result_if_signal_or_contact: deficit only in (a) and (d): axonal surface or substrate; only in (b)/(c): a soluble product; in none but (a): needs live contact
needs: existing Wwox-null embryos from existing crosses (no new colony); a laboratory that already holds the line
order_and_limits: before any drug arm; two independent experiments are the minimum and coverslips of one dish are not replicates

question: Do bursts or activity matter for the null-DRG deficit
arms: null and wild-type DRG each with: none; action-potential block; AMPA-receptor block; NMDA-receptor block; with and without a neuregulin-type or BDNF-type factor (switch of mode)
read_by_level: level 1 and level 2 per arm; neuronal firing recorded in the dish so that "reduced bursts" is verified
result_if_signal_or_contact: deficit unchanged by every activity arm: not an activity effect in this system; factor addition rescues: a switch-type signal is missing
result_if_activity_linked: deficit shrinks with block, or grows with the factor only when activity intact: activity-linked
needs: as X1; shared with the neuronal-activity package (INV-05) so the arms are not run twice
order_and_limits: after X1; cultured peripheral neurons do not equal cortical bursts

question: Does a differentiation enhancer raise functional myelin or only counts
system: null-DRG co-culture, then, if level 1 or 2 responds, treated callosal slice from existing S-KO animals
arms: enhancer arm and vehicle arm on null and on wild-type DRG; the wild-type arm is the adverse-effect control
read_by_level: all four levels where reachable: maturation, wrapping and EM, callosal latency in slice, no behaviour as a stand-in
result_if_signal_or_contact: counts up and EM/latency up: the enhancer acts below the missing signal
result_if_activity_linked: counts up with EM or latency unchanged or worse: the discordance seen in the neonatal wild-type clemastine study repeats
needs: only after X1 and X2; animals for the slice step are the already-bred S-KO
order_and_limits: limit: S-KO die at 3-4 weeks; treatment windows are the authors, not a regimen

question: Which GSK3 arm (Wnt, CREB, Notch) is live in null-neuron OPCs
system: null-DRG co-culture, OPCs isolated or stained in situ
arms: phospho-GSK3 and a substrate readout, nuclear beta-catenin, CREB and Notch target genes in OPCs; then inhibitors of at least two chemotypes versus a genetic control
result_if_signal_or_contact: only if X1 shows a level 1 defect
order_and_limits: a compound effect is not attributed to GSK3 without the genetic control; seizure effects of lithium are a separate question
